اقات «لائحة رأس الخيمة 2026» الموجودة في المنصة. تحقق من النسخة الرسمية قبل أي استخدام مهني.'),false));
}

/* ---------- jump handler for the new sources (they live in the books/references section) ---------- */
(function(){
  var prev=window.jumpToLecture;
  window.jumpToLecture=function(id){
    if(!/^src-/.test(id||'')){ return prev(id); }
    switchTab('library');
    setTimeout(function(){
      var acc=$('acc-learn-books'); if(acc) acc.open=true;
      var bk=$('bk-'+id.replace('src-','src'));
      var el=$('lib-'+id)||bk;
      if(el){
        var p=el.parentElement; while(p&&p!==document.body){ if(p.tagName==='DETAILS') p.open=true; p=p.parentElement; }
        el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});
        el.classList.add('um-flash'); setTimeout(function(){el.classList.remove('um-flash');},2200);
      }
    },90);
  };
})();

function fixCounts(){
  try{
    var nf=DEFAULT_FLASHCARDS.length+((window.appState&&appState.customFlashcards)?appState.customFlashcards.length:0), nq=QUIZ_SCENARIOS.length;
    var a=$('acc-fc-cards'), q=$('acc-fc-quiz');
    function rep(root,re,txt){ if(!root) return; var w=document.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,null); var n; while((n=w.nextNode())){ if(re.test(n.nodeValue)){ n.nodeValue=n.nodeValue.replace(re,txt); } } }
    rep(a,/\(\d+ بطاقة\)/,'('+nf+' بطاقة)');
    rep(q,/\(\d+ سيناريو\)/,'('+nq+' سيناريو)');
    var tab=$('tab-flashcards'); rep(tab,/\d+ بطاقة مراجعة ثلاثية الأبعاد \+ \d+ سيناريو/,nf+' بطاقة مراجعة ثلاثية الأبعاد + '+nq+' سيناريو');
  }catch(e){console.warn('V24 counts',e);}
}
function run(){
  fixCounts();
  try{ addSourceCards(); }catch(e){console.warn('V24 cards',e);}
  try{ addTabContent(); }catch(e){console.warn('V24 tabs',e);}
  try{ var bg=$('books-grid'); if(bg) bg.innerHTML=''; var lr=$('lc-root'); if(lr) lr.innerHTML=''; }catch(e){}
  try{ if(typeof renderLibrary==='function') renderLibrary(); }catch(e){console.warn(e);}
  try{ if(typeof bkRender==='function') bkRender(); }catch(e){console.warn(e);}
  try{ if(typeof populateFcCategories==='function') populateFcCategories(); if(typeof renderFlashcard==='function') renderFlashcard(); }catch(e){console.warn(e);}
  try{ if(typeof renderQuizScenario==='function') renderQuizScenario(); }catch(e){console.warn(e);}
  try{ qa('section.tab-panel details').forEach(function(d){ d.open=false; }); }catch(e){}
  try{ qa('section.tab-panel').forEach(function(p){ if(p.umPinHeaders) p.umPinHeaders(); }); }catch(e){}
}
if(document.readyState==='complete'){ setTimeout(run,300); }
else{ window.addEventListener('load',function(){ setTimeout(run,300); }); }
})();

</script>
<style>#books-grid-h{display:none!important}</style>
<script>
/* ===== UrbanMind V25: library restructure ===== */
(function(){
function $(i){return document.getElementById(i);}
function qa(s,r){return Array.prototype.slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(s));}
var SRC=['gopp','ubl','rak5'];
function clearSlots(){ qa('.src-card-slot').forEach(function(s){ if(s.getAttribute('data-sbc')) return; s.innerHTML=''; }); }
function distribute(){
  SRC.forEach(function(k){
    var card=$('lib-src-'+k), sum=$('bk-src'+k);
    var cs=document.querySelector('#acc-src-'+k+' .src-card-slot'), ss=document.querySelector('#acc-src-'+k+' .src-sum-slot');
    if(card&&cs&&card.parentNode!==cs) cs.appendChild(card);
    if(sum&&ss&&sum.parentNode!==ss) ss.appendChild(sum);
  });
}
function applyFilter(){
  var f='all'; try{ f=appState.libFilter||'all'; }catch(e){}
  var bg=$('books-grid'); if(!bg) return;
  qa(':scope > div',bg).forEach(function(c){
    var m=/^lib-book-(en|ar)-/.exec(c.id||'');
    c.style.display=(m&&f!=='all'&&m[1]!==f)?'none':'';
  });
}
function setTitle(acc,text){
  var sp=acc&&acc.querySelector('summary span'); if(!sp) return;
  var ic=sp.querySelector('i'); sp.innerHTML=(ic?ic.outerHTML+' ':'')+text;
}
function retitle(){
  var bg=$('books-grid'); var n=bg?qa(':scope > div',bg).length:0;
  setTitle($('acc-lib-bookcards'),'أولاً: بطاقات الكتب والمراجع ('+n+' مرجعاً عربياً وإنجليزياً)');
  setTitle($('acc-learn-books'),'ثانياً: تلخيصات الكتب (كتابان)');
}
function repinAll(){ qa('section.tab-panel').forEach(function(p){ if(p.umPinHeaders) try{p.umPinHeaders();}catch(e){} }); }
function openAnc(el){ var p=el; while(p&&p!==document.body){ if(p.tagName==='DETAILS') p.open=true; p=p.parentElement; } }

function restructure(){
  if($('acc-lib-bookcards')) return;
  var libTab=$('tab-library'), libAcc=$('acc-learn-library'), booksAcc=$('acc-learn-books'), learn=$('tab-learning');
  if(!libTab||!libAcc||!booksAcc||!learn) return;
  var libBody=libAcc.querySelector('.um-acc-body');
  var filterBar=libBody.querySelector('.lib-filter-btn')?libBody.querySelector('.lib-filter-btn').parentElement:null;
  /* 1. book cards become their own section in the library */
  var bc=document.createElement('details'); bc.id='acc-lib-bookcards'; bc.className='um-sec-acc bk-scope um-scope';
  bc.innerHTML='<summary><span><i class="fa-solid fa-book-open-reader text-amber-400 ml-2"></i> أولاً: بطاقات الكتب والمراجع</span><span class="text-xs font-mono text-amber-300">حالة القراءة + تلخيصك</span></summary><div class="um-acc-body space-y-4"></div>';
  var bcb=bc.querySelector('.um-acc-body');
  if(filterBar) bcb.appendChild(filterBar);
  var h=$('books-grid-h'), bg=$('books-grid');
  if(h) bcb.appendChild(h);
  if(bg) bcb.appendChild(bg);
  libTab.insertBefore(bc,booksAcc);
  /* 2. all lecture summaries become one section in the learning map */
  learn.appendChild(libAcc);
  /* 3. wrap re-renders so cards and summaries always land in their new places */
  var _rl=window.renderLibrary;
  if(typeof _rl==='function'){
    window.renderLibrary=function(){
      var f='all'; try{ f=appState.libFilter; appState.libFilter='all'; }catch(e){}
      var b=$('books-grid'); if(b) b.innerHTML=''; clearSlots();
      try{ _rl(); } finally { try{ appState.libFilter=f; }catch(e){} }
      distribute(); applyFilter(); retitle(); repinAll();
    };
  }
  var _bk=window.bkRender;
  if(typeof _bk==='function'){
    window.bkRender=function(){
      qa('.src-sum-slot').forEach(function(s){ s.innerHTML=''; });
      _bk(); distribute(); retitle(); repinAll();
    };
  }
  /* 4. sources tab: SBC card (copy; original stays at the top of tab 1) */
  var sbcSlot=document.querySelector('#acc-src-sbc .src-card-slot');
  var sbcCard=document.querySelector('#acc-sources .um-src-card[data-lec="sbc"]');
  if(sbcSlot&&sbcCard&&!sbcSlot.firstChild){ sbcSlot.appendChild(sbcCard.cloneNode(true)); sbcSlot.setAttribute('data-sbc','1'); }
  distribute(); applyFilter(); retitle();
  /* 5. routing */
  try{ TAB_ROUTE_ALIAS.library={tab:'library',open:'acc-lib-bookcards'}; }catch(e){}
  try{ NOTE_SECTIONS.push(['sources','11. مصادر المنصة']); if(typeof umNotesInit==='function') umNotesInit(); }catch(e){}
  qa('section.tab-panel details').forEach(function(d){ d.open=false; });
  repinAll();
}
window.jumpToLecture=function(id){
  id=id||'';
  if(id==='sbc'){ switchTab('code'); return; }
  var tab=/^src-/.test(id)?'sources':'learning';
  switchTab(tab);
  setTimeout(function(){
    var el=$('lib-'+id)||$('bk-'+id.replace('lec-','lec'))||$('bk-'+id);
    if(el){
      openAnc(el); repinAll();
      el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});
      el.classList.add('um-flash'); setTimeout(function(){el.classList.remove('um-flash');},2200);
    }
  },110);
};
function go(){ try{ restructure(); }catch(e){ console.error('V25 restructure',e); } }
if(document.readyState==='complete'){ setTimeout(go,900); }
else{ window.addEventListener('load',function(){ setTimeout(go,900); }); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ===== UrbanMind V25.1: linkify bare source URLs shown as plain text ===== */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 function linkify(root){
  var walker=document.createTreeWalker(root||document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
   acceptNode:function(n){
    if(!n.nodeValue||n.nodeValue.indexOf('http')===-1) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
    var p=n.parentElement;
    if(!p||p.closest('a,script,style,textarea,input,option')) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
    return /https?:\/\/[^\s<>"']+/.test(n.nodeValue)?NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT:NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
   }
  });
  var nodes=[],n;
  while((n=walker.nextNode())) nodes.push(n);
  nodes.forEach(function(tn){
   var re=/(https?:\/\/[^\s<>"']+)/g, m, last=0, frag=document.createDocumentFragment(), changed=false;
   while((m=re.exec(tn.nodeValue))){
    var url=m[1], trail='';
    while(/[.,;:!?،؛)]$/.test(url)){ trail=url.slice(-1)+trail; url=url.slice(0,-1); }
    if(!url) continue;
    changed=true;
    frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(tn.nodeValue.slice(last,m.index)));
    var a=document.createElement('a');
    a.href=url; a.target='_blank'; a.rel='noopener'; a.textContent=url;
    a.style.wordBreak='break-all'; a.style.color='#2dd4bf'; a.style.textDecoration='underline'; a.style.textUnderlineOffset='3px';
    frag.appendChild(a);
    last=m.index+m[1].length;
    if(trail) frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(trail));
   }
   if(changed){
    frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(tn.nodeValue.slice(last)));
    tn.parentNode.replaceChild(frag,tn);
   }
  });
 }
 if(document.readyState==='complete'){ setTimeout(linkify,1200); }
 else{ window.addEventListener('load',function(){ setTimeout(linkify,1200); }); }
})();
</script>
